title: manager plan · Advance research to inspect specific benchmark papers for descriptive
summary: Advance research to inspect specific benchmark papers for descriptive evidence, as the strict empirical comparison hypothesis is unfeasible.
body: The previous bounded task failed to find 4 sources comparing dynamic vs. static memory under fixed token budgets. Literature lacks controlled experiments matching resource constraints. Per protocol, we must now inspect sources describing agent memory approaches (dynamic vs. static) on general benchmarks, explicitly noting missing controls. We will search for papers reporting task success/hallucination rates on standard agent benchmarks (e.g., BigBench, GSM8K) to gather descriptive performance data without inferring superiority without direct baseline comparison.
